sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static conditional requirement: it targets ships, uses the canonical project namespace and supplied owners, selects the not_comminuted_or_disinfected discharge case, independently flags failure of the boolean applicability fact, MARPOL compliance, the strict distance threshold (>12 MI_N), nearby ice concentration threshold (>0.1 UNITLESS), and the required MI_N distance record. Datatypes and units are consistent, and no vocabulary repair is needed.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional violation query so that a matching sewageDischargeType cannot pass merely because notComminutedOrDisinfected is absent or false. The current FILTER NOT EXISTS nests the boolean applicability check with all obligations, creating an accidental pass when the selector is false. When sewageDischargeType is not_comminuted_or_disinfected, explicitly require notComminutedOrDisinfected = true and independently require MARPOL compliance = true, distanceToNearestIceShelfOrFastIce > 12 MI_N, nearbyIceConcentration > 0.1 UNITLESS, and the distanceFromAreaWithIceConcentrationAboveOneTenth MI_N record. Preserve the declared ship ownership and units; no vocabulary matcher is needed.

Repair the conditional violation query as required by the prior feedback. The current FILTER NOT EXISTS still nests notComminutedOrDisinfected=true together with all other obligations, so a matching sewageDischargeType can pass when that applicability fact is absent or false. For the selector sewageDischargeType="not_comminuted_or_disinfected", independently require notComminutedOrDisinfected=true and independently flag absence or failure of MARPOL compliance=true, distanceToNearestIceShelfOrFastIce > 12 MI_N, nearbyIceConcentration > 0.1 UNITLESS, and the MI_N distanceFromAreaWithIceConcentrationAboveOneTenth record. Structure the violation logic so failure of any one obligation produces a violation; do not use one conjunctive NOT EXISTS that passes when any obligation is missing. Preserve the ship target, canonical terms, datatypes, and units; no vocabulary matcher is needed.

The candidate faithfully encodes the direct-static conditional requirement: it targets ships, uses the canonical project namespace and supplied owners, selects the not_comminuted_or_disinfected discharge case, independently flags failure of the boolean applicability fact, MARPOL compliance, the strict distance threshold (>12 MI_N), nearby ice concentration threshold (>0.1 UNITLESS), and the required MI_N distance record. Datatypes and units are consistent, and no vocabulary repair is needed.
